detailZones.title: Locker doors and frame
detailZones.description: Inspect the left locker doors, top frame, vents, hinges and visible dial hardware.

detailZones.title: Open locker compartment
detailZones.description: Focus on the open compartment, shelf, coat hook, inner door and visible lower cubby.

detailZones.title: Right locker doors
detailZones.description: Compare the right-side blue and sage doors, their vents, frames and separate lock hardware.

detailZones.title: Backpack and school items
detailZones.description: Trace the backpack pockets and straps, lunch container and clear water bottle beside the lockers.

detailZones.title: Bench, books and clothing
detailZones.description: Inspect the timber bench, closed exercise book, pencil pouch and folded rain jacket.

anchorAudit.rationale: The final 1600 by 900 photograph was reviewed at native size. It retains 75 independently pointable locker structures, compartment parts, footwear, student storage items, stationery, clothing and bench parts across five non-overlapping focus regions. Student identity, readable labels, school branding, activities and hidden contents were excluded.
